JavaSDM is a good tool for extracting synonyms from chat log data and that the results depend heavily on preprocessing and extraction criteria.
JavaSDM is a good synonym extraction tool-kit, but that it needs some preprocessing of data before it is ready to use.

JavaSDM works better on the Swedish than on the English collections, that the extended gold standard is a better gold standard, that lemmatizing training data increases f-score, that lemmatising and POS-tagging training data decreases f-score and that a cosine similarity score of 0.5 is a good compromise between precision and recall.
